name: Desk Stretches
description: Eight gentle stretches to try at your desk, one card at a time.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A short deck of gentle stretches for a desk break, shown on Calm Cards.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Try one stretch or all eight.
howToPlay: Read the stretch on the card.
Press Show more for a few words on how to do it.
Move gently and stop if anything feels uncomfortable.
tips: These are general ideas for a break, not advice. Skip any that do not suit you.
